data.name: Sidestream Games
data.detailed_description:
🎮 Playing Alone on Stream Isn't Enough Anymore 🎮

Sidestream Games is your hub for interactive, stream-friendly games designed to bring your audience into the action.

Our growing collection of chill, easy-to-drop-into games lets you reward your subs, give your patrons a reason to cheer, and let your chat influence the way you play - all in real time.

Streaming doesn’t have to be a one-way street. With Sidestream Games, you can keep things lively, build stronger connections with your viewers, and most importantly... have fun together.

👤 Turn viewers into Co-Players.

Streaming is more competitive than ever – passive play doesn't cut it. Sidestream brings streamers and viewers together in real-time games that enhance live content.

🚀 A growing platform of chill, interactive games designed for streamers.

Use them to:

  • Reward your subs and patrons

  • Let chat influence your gameplay

  • Keep your audience engaged – and having fun!

🎲 How it works?

Streamer starts a Sidestream game 🡺 Viewers interact via chat 🡺 Results appear in real time on stream!

☕ Need a Coffee Break? Streaming is exhausting. Keep the Fun Going!

Step away without losing your audience. With AFK-ready games, your viewers stay entertained:

  • Organize chaotic melees

  • Host epic mage battles

  • Let your stream run while you recharge

💬 Make Your Stream Interactive: Let your audience do more than watch.

With Intermission Games, chat can:

  • Join the game

  • Influence outcomes

  • Stay active and involved

Turn viewers into participants.

🎁 A Fun Way to Do Giveaways: Forget boring countdowns.

Use our games to pick a winner with flair. It’s random – but with style. Let the battle decide who gets the loot!

Instead of silent timers, you get audience-driven mini-events that keep viewers watching, chatting, and cheering.

Disclaimer: this version of Intermission Games works only with Twitch. We plan and work towards making it accessible to streamers who create on other streaming platforms.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or greater
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel UHD Graphics 620 or similar
  • Storage: 100 MB available space
